_readme: SharkOS-CE car signal map. Each signal lists where to READ and WRITE it, in order of preference.
caradapter: one of hvac, body, setting, seat, power, cabin, assist, general, sensor, cloud, or * (try every adapter). This is the Shark 6's own car service.
bydauto: an android.hardware.bydauto device class, e.g. statistic.BYDAutoStatisticDevice.
methods: candidate method names, tried in order. args: fixed leading arguments. Writes append the value as the last argument.
scale/offset: shown value = raw * scale + offset.
labels: name -> raw code. -1 means 'not known yet' (the Off-road page can learn these by long-press).
Method names come from head-unit APK and Car Explorer analysis. Raw encodings (seat levels, gear codes, temperature scale) are
best guesses: check them on the Diagnostics screen and correct them here.
To override without rebuilding: copy this file to /sdcard/Android/data/com.sharkhome.launcher/files/shark6_codes.json and restart the app.

stat.evKm._note: Lifetime km driven in EV mode. Read 14059 on 7 Nov (EV 14059 + HEV 3447 = odometer 17506). Used by the real-range estimate.

stat.hevKm._note: Lifetime km driven in HEV mode. Read 3447 on 7 Nov.

stat.totalElecKwh._note: Lifetime electricity used, kWh. Read 3612.3 on 7 Nov (= 25.7 kWh/100 km over the EV km).

stat.totalFuelL._note: Lifetime fuel used, litres. Read 354.5 on 7 Nov (= 10.3 L/100 km over the HEV km; BYD shows 2.0 because it divides by ALL km).

stat.socFloor._note: Lowest battery % the car drives down to in EV before the engine takes over. Read 25.

motor.frontRpm._note: cloud.getDriverMotorSpeed(1) = front motor. Read 14999 with the car stopped (8 Nov), so zero = 15000: offset -15000 applied. Scale (rpm per unit) unverified while driving.

motor.rearRpm._note: cloud.getDriverMotorSpeed(2) = rear motor. Read 29999 stopped, so zero = 30000: offset -30000 applied. Scale unverified.

motor.frontTorque._note: cloud.getDriverMotorTorque(1). Read 5000 stopped, so zero = 5000 (offset -5000 applied). Scale unverified.

motor.rearTorque._note: cloud.getDriverMotorTorque(2). Read 0 stopped (unlike front = 5000). RAW, unverified.

motor.frontTemp._note: cloud.getDriverMotorTemperature(1). Offset -40 for standard CAN motor temperature.

motor.rearTemp._note: cloud.getDriverMotorTemperature(2). Offset -40 for standard CAN motor temperature.

motor.frontVolt._note: cloud.getMotorMCUGeneratrixVolt(1). Read 368 parked = 368 V HV bus.

motor.rearVolt._note: cloud.getMotorMCUGeneratrixVolt(2). Read 368 parked = 368 V HV bus.

battery.voltage._note: battery_service.getBatteryVoltage(1) via OtaTsUpdateService. On the car (8 Nov 2026, parked, plugged in) arg 1 reads 13 = volts already: scale 1.

drive.mode._note: setting.getDriveMode: 0 Eco, 1 Normal, 2 Sport (1 read in Normal). READ ONLY: this firmware has no setDriveMode (checked 14 Nov), so the write entry never works and the app only shows it.

drive.regenLevel._note: VERIFIED 14 Nov 2026 by switching BYD's own Regenerative Braking (Energy page): Standard = 2, High = 3.

chassis.brakeFeel._note: VERIFIED 14 Nov 2026 by switching BYD's own Brake Assist Mode: Comfort = 0, Sport = 1 (the old 1/2 guess made 'Comfort' actually set Sport and 'Sport' write 2 do nothing). WRITE codes differ from READ codes: setBrakePedalMode(2) gives read 0 (Comfort), setBrakePedalMode(1) gives read 1 (Sport); setBrakePedalMode(0) does nothing.

chassis.steerFeel._note: VERIFIED 14 Nov 2026 by switching BYD's own Steering Assist Mode: Comfort = 1, Sport = 3.

chassis.autoHold._note: Auto Hold, READ ONLY. bydauto ADAS getAVHState and assist.getAutoParkingState both read 0 when OFF.

chassis.stability._note: Stability control (ESC). SAFETY SYSTEM. Read: assist.getElecCarBodyStablySysState 0 = ON, 1 = OFF. Write (owner-authorised 14 Nov 2026, Drive tab only): assist.setElecCarBodyStablySysState(1) = turn OFF, (2) = turn ON; this is exactly what BYD's own quick-settings EspOff tile sends (found in BydCarSystemUI). Written from the Drive tab (one tap) or by Startup Memory when the user ticks Remember on it. No speed limit or blocklist (owner's decision, GitHub #7, 20 Nov 2026).

chassis.sandAbs._note: Sand ABS mode status. SAFETY SYSTEM: READ ONLY.

chassis.slope._note: sensor.getSlope read 255 parked (no value?); bydauto sensor getSlope read -1.

chassis.steeringAngle._note: body.getSteeringWheelValue(1) = steering angle. Read 65490 parked = unsigned 16-bit for -46 (-4.6 deg). VehicleRepository decodes unsigned 16-bit to signed; scale 0.1 gives degrees.

trip.distance._note: general.getCurrentTripMileage. Scaled by 0.1 km if reported in 0.1 km, or 1.0.

trailer.size._note: setting.getTrailerDragType / setTrailerDragType. Small = 1, Medium = 2, Large = 3 (reads 15 when trailer mode is off).

trailer.lightCheck._note: setting.getTrailerLightCheckState / setTrailerLightCheckState. Cycles trailer lights for solo walk-around check.

tyre.tempFl._note: Front left tyre temperature (°C). Raw is °C + 40: all four read 68 parked at 29 °C outside (8 Nov 2026), so offset -40. Unverified while driving.

tyre.tempFr._note: Front right tyre temperature (°C). Raw is °C + 40: all four read 68 parked at 29 °C outside (8 Nov 2026), so offset -40. Unverified while driving.

tyre.tempRl._note: Rear left tyre temperature (°C). Raw is °C + 40: all four read 68 parked at 29 °C outside (8 Nov 2026), so offset -40. Unverified while driving.

tyre.tempRr._note: Rear right tyre temperature (°C). Raw is °C + 40: all four read 68 parked at 29 °C outside (8 Nov 2026), so offset -40. Unverified while driving.

vehicle.evMileage._note: Total lifetime EV mileage (km), e.g. 14059 km.

vehicle.hevMileage._note: Total lifetime HEV mileage (km), e.g. 3447 km.

energy.drivePct50km._note: Last 50 km energy used by drivetrain (%), e.g. 88%.

energy.acPct50km._note: Last 50 km energy used by A/C (%), e.g. 7%.

energy.auxPct50km._note: Last 50 km energy used by vehicle electronics/appliances (%), e.g. 5%.

energy.socTarget._note: Target battery SOC % for HEV Hold / AI-Save (25..70%).

energy.socSave._note: SAVE / Battery Hold switch (BYD Quick Settings QSPanelPresenter.setMandatoryElectricState). Verified on car 16 Nov 2026: 2 = on, 1 = off (inverted vs standard BYD 1=on/2=off; takes ~1.5s to read back).

cabin.wirelessPower._note: Front wireless phone charger power (W), e.g. 15 or 50 W.

advanced.wirelessCharge._note: Wireless charging pad switch (1 = on, 2 = off).

climate.dualSync._note: Hardware Dual/Sync mode on HVAC module (1 = Sync/Single, 2 = Dual).

advanced.hud._note: Head-Up Display (HUD) master switch (1 = on, 2 = off).

advanced.hudSnow._note: HUD Mode / Snow Mode (BydCarSettings BYDAutoSettingDevice.getHudMode / setHudMode). Verified on car 16 Nov 2026: 1 = on, 2 = off (both round-trips confirmed=true).

advanced.blindSpot._note: Blind Spot Detection (BSD) mirror alert (1 = on, 2 = off).

advanced.mirrorFold._note: Exterior mirrors auto-fold on lock (BydCarSettings getAutoExternalRearMirrorFollowUpSwitch / setAutoExternalRearMirrorFollowUpSwitch). Verified on car 16 Nov 2026: 1 = on, 2 = off (both round-trips confirmed=true).

body.cargoLight._note: Ute tub / cargo bed light switch (CarAdapterService body.getCargoLightSwitchState / setCargoLightSwitchState). Verified on car 16 Nov 2026: 1 = on, 2 = off (off takes ~1-2s to read back).

display.screenRotation._note: Centre screen rotation (the screen physically turns). Write = what BYD's SystemUI dock sends: BYDAutoSettingDevice.setScreenRotation(1 = landscape, 2 = portrait), read from its auto-rotate code (sends 2 when landscape and asked for portrait). VERIFIED on the car 20 Nov 2026 from the Quick panel Rotate screen tile (GitHub #5): 2 turned the screen to portrait (display 1080x1920), 1 back to landscape. The read getScreenAngle stays 0 in both orientations, so it cannot confirm the write; the app uses Android's own orientation instead.

climate.power._note: Same calls as BYD's climate app: BYDAutoAcDevice.start(0)/stop(0), AC_POWER_OFF=0/ON=1. The caradapter getAcStartState uses a different encoding (2 = off), so it is not read here.

climate.tempDriver._note: BYD Shark 6 HVAC uses integer degrees Celsius (17..32). HvacAdapterManager.getTempratureMain / setAcTemperatureMain(int).

climate.tempPassenger._note: BYD Shark 6 HVAC uses integer degrees Celsius (17..32). HvacAdapterManager.getTempratureDeputy / setAcTemperatureDeputy(int).

climate.auto._note: Verified 2026-11-07 (BYD climate app + BydHvac ACManagerImpl): caradapter getAcControlMode 2 = Auto, 1 = Manual. Write is the two-arg HvacAdapterManager.setAcControlMode(device, mode) with the same codes (the one-arg version doesn't exist). BYDAutoAcDevice uses 0 = Auto, 1 = Manual and translates. Changing airflow in BYD's app drops Auto to manual.

climate.ac._note: setAcCompressorState/getAcCompressorState are empty stubs in the caradapter. setAcCompressorMode(source, mode) goes straight to the car's setAcTurnOn: 1 = on, 2 = off, 0 = no request (ignored). Reads report 1 = on, 0 = off. Tested on the car 2026-11-05: on works with 1, off with 0 did nothing.
climate.ac._note2: On this car, A/C on also starts the whole climate system (onAcStarted, fan 5). If the compressor-off request isn't confirmed, off falls back to stopping the climate, which is what BYD's own off does (onAcStoped, compressor 0).

climate.recirc._note: CORRECTED 21 Nov 2026 (v0.6.778): the 20 Nov encoding was inverted. Checked against BYD's own climate screen (loop arrow inside the car = recirculate, arrow entering from outside = fresh air): BYDAutoAcDevice.setAcCycleMode(0, 1) = RECIRCULATE, (0, 0) = FRESH AIR. The caradapter read getAcCycleMode reports 2 = recirculate, 1 = fresh. The caradapter setter only exists with two arguments, so the old one-argument write never ran. The state is independent of the climate being on.

climate.defrostFront._note: BYD HVAC: 1 = off, 2 = on. Checked against logcat on car.

climate.defrostRear._note: Verified 2026-11-07 from BYD's climate app: BYDAutoAcDevice.setAcDefrostState(device, area 2, state) with 1 = on, 0 = off; getAcDefrostState(2) reads the same. The wrapper turns state 1 -> 2 and 0 -> 1 and calls HvacAdapterManager.setElectricDefrostState, so the raw caradapter code is 2 = on, 1 = off (sending 1 was why the old map never switched it on).

climate.maxCool._note: Read 2 with the climate off, so off = 2 (BYD's usual 1 = on, 2 = off).

seat.heatDriver._note: READ: 1 = off, 2 = low, 3 = high. WRITE is reversed: setSeatHeatingStateDriver(3) = off, (2) = low, (1) = high. Driver heat and vent verified on the car 2026-11-08 (Low and Off confirmed by read-back); passenger not yet tested.

seat.heatPassenger._note: READ: 1 = off, 2 = low, 3 = high. WRITE is reversed: setSeatHeatingStatePassenger(3) = off, (2) = low, (1) = high. Driver heat and vent verified on the car 2026-11-08 (Low and Off confirmed by read-back); passenger not yet tested.

seat.ventDriver._note: READ: 1 = off, 2 = low, 3 = high. WRITE is reversed: setSeatVentilatingStateDriver(3) = off, (2) = low, (1) = high. Driver heat and vent verified on the car 2026-11-08 (Low and Off confirmed by read-back); passenger not yet tested.

seat.ventPassenger._note: READ: 1 = off, 2 = low, 3 = high. WRITE is reversed: setSeatVentilatingStatePassenger(3) = off, (2) = low, (1) = high. Driver heat and vent verified on the car 2026-11-08 (Low and Off confirmed by read-back); passenger not yet tested.

tyre.fl._note: Pressure in psi. The car reports psi x 10 (read 372 = 37.2 psi).

tyre.fr._note: Pressure in psi. The car reports psi x 10 (read 372 = 37.2 psi).

tyre.rl._note: Pressure in psi. The car reports psi x 10 (read 372 = 37.2 psi).

tyre.rr._note: Pressure in psi. The car reports psi x 10 (read 372 = 37.2 psi).

drive.roadMode._note: Terrain mode (getGoalRoadMode). VERIFIED 14 Nov 2026 by cycling the car's scroll wheel: Normal 1, Snow 2, Mud 3, Sand 4, Mountain 5. Eco and Sport do NOT change this code (it stays 1): they are the separate drive.mode signal. Wading is switched on in BYD settings and its code is not known. READ ONLY in SharkOS-CE: terrain modes are chosen on the scroll wheel (BYD confirms some of them, which change safety systems).

drive.hillDescent._note: Verified 2026-11-07 with BYD's ADAS > Safety Assist > Hill Descent Control switch: caradapter.assist.getSteepDescentSlowDownState reads 1 = on, 0 = off. caradapter.cabin.getHdcState stayed 0 with the switch on (probably 'HDC actively braking'), so it isn't read here. BYDAutoADASDevice.setHDCState is an empty stub. BYDAutoDiPilotDevice.setSteepDescentSlowDownState passes straight through to the assist adapter. Writes: 1 = on (confirmed), 0 = ignored (no request), so off writes 2.

advanced.laneAssist._note: BydCarSettings ActiveSafeViewModel: getLaneAssistType reads 0 = off, 1 = warning, 2 = prevention, 3 = all (on). Writing uses BYD CAN command codes: setLaneAssistType(1) = off, setLaneAssistType(4) = all (on), setLaneAssistType(5) = prevention, setLaneAssistType(2) = warning.

advanced.speedLimitWarning._note: Intelligent Speed Limit Warning (BYD ADAS > Safety Assist > Traffic Sign Recognition). Verified on the car 16 Nov 2026. READ getIntelligentSpeedLimitAlert2B4State: 1 = on, 0 = off (getIsliWarningLevelSwitchStatus moves the other way, 2 = on, 1 = off, but its setter does NOT change the car). WRITE setIntelligentSpeedLimitAlertState: 2 = on, 1 = off (confirmed by read-back). The car reports the change 3-5 s after the write, hence confirmMs 7000. The old entry read the ISLI value with inverted labels and wrote ISLI/Alert 2 for 'off', which switched the warning ON.

advanced.trafficSign._note: Traffic Sign Recognition master switch (BYD ADAS > Safety Assist). Found 16 Nov 2026 by toggling BYD's switch in the explorer: READ getTrafficSignRecognize2B4State 1 = on, 0 = off (the dash sign value getTrafficSignRecognitionValue goes to 255 when off). WRITE setTrafficSignRecognizeState; encoding tried in order and confirmed by read-back (the car answers 3-5 s late). setSlifState does nothing. Switching it off greys out the three speed-limit options in BYD's screen.

advanced.speedLimitControl._note: Intelligent Speed Limit Control (BYD ADAS > Safety Assist). Verified 16 Nov 2026 read: ON = getIntelligentSpeedLimitControl32FState 1, OFF = 0 (getIntelligentSpeedLimitControlStateSecond moves with it). Write encoding is tried in order and confirmed by read-back.

advanced.speedLimitTone._note: Speed Limit Change Prompt Tone (BYD ADAS > Safety Assist). Verified 16 Nov 2026 read: getTsrLitSpdChgSwitchState 0 = tone ON, 1 = tone OFF (inverted). Write encoding is tried in order and confirmed by read-back.

advanced.childPresence._note: BydCarSettings CockpitPerFragment: BYDAutoDiPilotDevice.getCpdStatus / setCpdStatus uses 1 = on (or 3 = normal/delay on), 2 = off.

advanced.dashMap._note: BydCarSettings InstrumentFragment adds +1 to button index: 1 = Simple, 2 = Full screen via BYDAutoInstrumentDevice.setInsNaviDisplayMode (requires BYDAUTO_INSTRUMENT_SET).

vehicle.fuelAvg._note: L/100 km over the last 50 km. Seen on the car: 6.9.

vehicle.speedKmh._note: CarSensorServiceImpl: getCurrentSpeed reads CarPropertyValue 0x21406006 (instrument cluster speed in km/h); getSpeedValue reads 0x21604601 (CAN wheel/ESP speed in km/h); getIpbVehicleSpeedStatusR reads CarVendorSpeedManager.

vehicle.speedLimitKmh._note: Traffic Sign Recognition (TSR) road speed limit in km/h (255 = no sign recognized / unavailable). Observed in CarExplorer via caradapter.general.getTrafficSignRecognitionValue.

vehicle.powerKw._note: Unverified: body.getEnginePower read -5 while the car was charging, so it looks like drive power in kW (negative = regen/charging). Check it while driving.

vehicle.chargingPower._note: AC/DC charging power in kW. caradapter.body.getChargingPower returns kW (e.g. 5.3) when plugged in, or a sentinel ~359.4 when unplugged.

vehicle.dischargePower._note: V2L external discharge power in kW. caradapter.cabin.getExternalChargingPower returns W, scaled by 0.001 to kW.

vehicle.brake._note: Unverified encoding: read 0 with the pedal up.

climate.insideTemp._note: Guess: no inside-temperature getter found in the 5 Nov export.

body.locked._note: BYD's own screen said Unlocked while this read 1, so 1 = unlocked. Locked = 2 is assumed.

light.lowBeam._note: Verified 2026-11-07: switching the headlights off and on logged LIGHT_LOW_BEAM_LIGHT 2 then 1, so 1 = on, 2 = off (the car keeps them on when it's dark, e.g. in a garage).

light.turnSignal._note: Verified 2026-11-07 on the car (LightManagerImpl onTurnLightStateChanged + Car explorer): 1 = off, 2 = left, 4 = right, 6 = hazards (bit flags). Steady while the bulbs flash. body.getLightLeftTurnSignal / getLightRightTurnSignal stayed 0 throughout, so they aren't used.

light.brakeLamp._note: Verified 2026-11-07 on the car (onStopLightStateChanged while pressing the brake): caradapter.body.getStopLightState 1 = brake lights on, 3 = off. Drives the brake lights in the car picture.

door.driver._note: caradapter.cabin.isDriverDoorOpen (boolean, read as 1/0). All read false with the doors shut (7 Nov). Open = 1 to confirm on the car.

climate.airflow._note: Verified 2026-11-07 from BYD's climate app (HvacListener onAcWindModeChanged): 1 = face, 2 = face + feet, 3 = feet, 4 = feet + windscreen, 6 = face + feet + windscreen. BYDAutoAcDevice passes the value straight through to HvacAdapterManager.setAcWindMode(device, mode).

vehicle.rangeKm._note: Combined range. Read 288 on the car (43 EV + 245 fuel).

display.dayNight._note: Instrument cluster day/night mode, NOT the BYD theme: read 1 at 10 am, -1 at 8 pm (16 Nov 2026) and the app showed light while BYD was in dark mode at 6:17 pm (20 Nov, GitHub #8). The Auto theme now follows Android night mode (set by BYD's theme) and uses this only as a fallback. Unverified: night is assumed to be 2.

trailer.limitSmall._note: READ ONLY, value unverified: setting.getTrailerSmallLimitWeight (added 14 Nov to learn what the car reports; if it reads a plausible kg figure the Tow tab shows it).

wading.state._note: READ ONLY, encoding unverified: setting.getWadingPatternStateTips (0 parked).

chassis.espOffKey._note: READ ONLY SAFETY SYSTEM, encoding unverified: assist.getEspOffKeyStatus (should show whether the ESP-off button is pressed). Never write.

chassis.hdcState._note: READ ONLY, encoding unverified: cabin.getHdcState stayed 0 with the HDC switch on (probably 'HDC actively braking').

cabin.doorLight._note: READ ONLY, value unverified: Auto indoor light (BYDAutoLightDevice.getDoorLightState).

cabin.ambientLight._note: READ ONLY, value unverified: Ambient light state (BYDAutoLightDevice.getAmbientState).

tbox.networkState._note: READ ONLY, value unverified: T-Box cellular state (BYDAutoTBoxDevice.getTBoxNetworkState(0)).

health.oilLifetime._note: READ ONLY, value unverified: Engine oil lifetime (caradapter.cabin.getOilLifetimeEngine).

charging.v2lToggle._note: READ ONLY, value unverified: V2L discharge toggle (BYDAutoChargingDevice.getDischargeToggle).

charging.v2lVoltage._note: READ ONLY, value unverified: V2L discharge voltage (BYDAutoChargingDevice.getDischargeVoltage).

charging.v2lCurrent._note: READ ONLY, value unverified: V2L discharge current (BYDAutoChargingDevice.getDischargeElectric).

trip.aKm._note: VERIFIED READ-ONLY ON CAR (20 Nov 2026): Trip A odometer, km. Read 6653.6 (5 Nov), 6698.0 (7 Nov), 6975.4 (20 Nov, exact +277.4 km odometer delta).

trip.bKm._note: VERIFIED READ-ONLY ON CAR (20 Nov 2026): Trip B odometer, km. Read 7462.4 (5 Nov), 7506.8 (7 Nov), 7784.2 (20 Nov, exact +277.4 km odometer delta).

trip.drivingHours._note: UNVERIFIED (found in decompile research 16 Nov 2026, read-only). READ ONLY, unverified meaning. general.getDrivingTimeValue(): float. Read 87.2 then 88.7, probably hours driven since a reset. Compare with getResetTripTimeHour (100 then 102).

charging.timeLeftH._note: UNVERIFIED (found in decompile research 16 Nov 2026, read-only). READ ONLY. body.getChargingRestTime(): int[] = [hours, minutes]. Read [2, 27] while AC charging at 5.3 kW (5 Nov), [255, 255] when not charging. The JSON reader keeps only element 0 (hours). Minutes need a small code change. Treat 255 as not charging.

charging.portLock._note: UNVERIFIED (found in decompile research 16 Nov 2026, read-only). READ ONLY, encoding unverified. body.getChargingPortLockRebackState(): int. Read 3 (5 Nov, gun in, charging) then 1 (7 Nov). Probably the charge-port lock state.

vehicle.heading._note: UNVERIFIED (found in decompile research 16 Nov 2026, read-only). READ ONLY, likely compass heading in degrees (0-359). cabin.getPositionDegree(): int. Read 269 then 271 when parked in the same place. cabin.getPositionStatus read 7 (fix quality?). Check while driving.

belt.driver._note: UNVERIFIED (found in decompile research 16 Nov 2026, read-only). READ ONLY, encoding unverified. Read 0 (5 Nov) then 1 (7 Nov). Rear belts also read 1 with nobody in the back, so 1 may mean unbuckled. Buckle and unbuckle to check. Alternative: general.getDriverBeltStatus.

belt.passenger._note: UNVERIFIED (found in decompile research 16 Nov 2026, read-only). READ ONLY, encoding unverified (read 1). Passenger occupancy: setting.getPassengerStatePassenger (read 1).

belt.rearLeft._note: UNVERIFIED (found in decompile research 16 Nov 2026, read-only). READ ONLY, encoding unverified (read 1, seat empty). Alternative: setting.getLeftRearSafebeltStatus.

belt.rearMiddle._note: UNVERIFIED (found in decompile research 16 Nov 2026, read-only). READ ONLY, encoding unverified (read 1, seat empty).

belt.rearRight._note: UNVERIFIED (found in decompile research 16 Nov 2026, read-only). READ ONLY, encoding unverified (read 1, seat empty).

window.frontLeft._note: UNVERIFIED (found in decompile research 16 Nov 2026, read-only). READ ONLY. Window open %, 0 = closed (read 0 with windows shut). The open-percent scale has not been checked with a window open. body.getWindowStateLeftFront read 1.

window.frontRight._note: UNVERIFIED (found in decompile research 16 Nov 2026, read-only). READ ONLY. Window open %, 0 = closed.

window.rearLeft._note: UNVERIFIED (found in decompile research 16 Nov 2026, read-only). READ ONLY. Window open %, 0 = closed.

window.rearRight._note: UNVERIFIED (found in decompile research 16 Nov 2026, read-only). READ ONLY. Window open %, 0 = closed.

window.ctl.frontLeft._note: WRITE ONLY (no read; use window.frontLeft for the open %). BYD's own voice assistant moves windows with BYDAutoBodyworkDevice.setWindowControlState(int[4]) (read from its APK 21 Nov 2026). Array index 0 = front left, 1 = front right, 2 = rear left, 3 = rear right; value 0 = leave alone, 1 = open, 2 = close. VERIFIED ON THE CAR 21 Nov 2026 on index 0: [1,0,0,0] opened it, [2,0,0,0] closed it (open % read 9, 88, 97 as it travelled). Windows are slow, so the generic confirm reports 'not reported yet'. Refused by the car while the window/child lock is on. Codes 4 (half) and 5 (small gap) exist but are unconfirmed.

window.ctl.frontRight._note: WRITE ONLY. Index 1 of setWindowControlState(int[4]) (front right). Same codes as window.ctl.frontLeft; NOT yet tried on the car.

radar.frontLeft._note: UNVERIFIED (found in decompile research 16 Nov 2026, read-only). READ ONLY. Parking-sensor obstacle distance. Read 0 when parked with nothing near; unit unverified (probably cm, 0 = nothing detected). Probe state read 150 on every sensor (likely idle or not active). Check in reverse near a wall.

radar.frontRight._note: UNVERIFIED (found in decompile research 16 Nov 2026, read-only). READ ONLY. See radar.frontLeft.

radar.rearLeft._note: UNVERIFIED (found in decompile research 16 Nov 2026, read-only). READ ONLY. See radar.frontLeft.

radar.rearMidLeft._note: UNVERIFIED (found in decompile research 16 Nov 2026, read-only). READ ONLY. See radar.frontLeft.

radar.rearMidRight._note: UNVERIFIED (found in decompile research 16 Nov 2026, read-only). READ ONLY. See radar.frontLeft.

radar.rearRight._note: UNVERIFIED (found in decompile research 16 Nov 2026, read-only). READ ONLY. See radar.frontLeft.

light.rearFog._note: UNVERIFIED (found in decompile research 16 Nov 2026, read-only). READ ONLY, BYD style probably (1 = on, 2 = off). Read 2. Front: body.getLightFrontFog (read 0).

mirror.folded._note: UNVERIFIED (found in decompile research 16 Nov 2026, read-only). READ ONLY. Exterior mirror fold state. Read 2 with mirrors out (probably 1 = folded, 2 = unfolded; unverified).

power.undervoltage12v._note: UNVERIFIED (found in decompile research 16 Nov 2026, read-only). READ ONLY, encoding unverified. body.getSystemUndervoltageStatus(): int. Read 1 (normal?). body.getBatteryVoltageLevel also read 1.

tyre.warning._note: UNVERIFIED (found in decompile research 16 Nov 2026, read-only). READ ONLY. TPMS warning hint, read 0 (no warning). Per wheel: body.getTyrePressureWarnLeftFront/RightFront/LeftRear/RightRear (all 0). body.getTyreSystemState 0.

energy.saveMemory._note: VERIFIED ON CAR (20 Nov 2026): SAVE mode memory (BYDAutoEnergyDevice.getMemoryElectricState / setMemoryElectricState). 1 = on, 2 = off (0 ignored). Confirmed 1->2->1.

energy.sportMemory._note: VERIFIED ON CAR (20 Nov 2026): SPORT mode memory (BYDAutoEnergyDevice.getMemorySportState / setMemorySportState). 1 = on, 2 = off (0 ignored). Confirmed 1->2->1.

locks.lockCloseWindows._note: VERIFIED ON CAR (20 Nov 2026): Auto close windows after locking (BYDAutoSettingDevice.getLockCarRiseWindow / setLockCarRiseWindow). 1 = on, 2 = off (0 ignored). Confirmed 1->2->1.

vehicle.autoWiper._note: VERIFIED ON CAR (20 Nov 2026): Auto rain wiper (BYDAutoSettingDevice.getAutoRainWiperState / setAutoRainWiperState). 1 = on, 2 = off (0 ignored). Confirmed 1->2->1.
